skill.name: Third-Party Script Loading Control
skill.description: Manage loading and execution timing of third-party scripts to prevent performance degradation and blocking of the main thread. Use when integrating analytics, ads, or external services that do not block initial page render.
skill.skill_body:
Use the Script Component to wrap third-party scripts. Configure the loading strategy (e.g., afterInteractive, lazyOnload, or worker) based on script priority and dependency. Verify that scripts load asynchronously and do not block the main rendering thread.

## Objective

control_script_execution
## Applicable Signals

- External script dependency identified
- Analytics or tracking service integration required
- Third-party ad network or service integration
- Performance audit reveals script blocking

## Contraindications

- Critical inline scripts required for initial page render
- Scripts with no external dependencies or performance impact
- Synchronous scripts that must execute before page interaction

## Intervention Moves

- Wrap third-party script in Script Component
- Select appropriate loading strategy (afterInteractive, lazyOnload, worker, or beforeInteractive)
- Verify script executes asynchronously without blocking main thread
- Test page interactivity during and after script load

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Identify third-party script and its purpose (analytics, ads, tracking, etc.)'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Determine script priority and whether it blocks page interactivity'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Select loading strategy: afterInteractive (default), lazyOnload, worker, or beforeInteractive'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Wrap script in Script Component with chosen strategy'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Verify script loads asynchronously and does not block main thread'}
- {'step': 6, 'action': 'Test page interactivity and performance metrics'}

## Constraints

- Script Component must be used for third-party scripts only
- Loading strategy must match script priority and dependency chain
- Main thread blocking must be prevented

## Cautions

- Verify script dependencies are resolved before execution
- Test script execution order if multiple third-party scripts are present
- Monitor for race conditions between script loads

## Output Contract

- Third-party scripts load asynchronously without blocking the main thread; execution timing is controlled per script strategy; page remains interactive during script load.
